_evidence: 256-byte character translation table at 0x833e18, read only by 0x0054d755 (mov al,[al+0x833e18]); it is zero in the image and filled once at start-up by 0x0054d70c (stosb of the CRT case-conversion call 0x5a4972 for al = 0..255). Any byte value is a valid entry (callers only compare, store or rescan the result: 0x0052f4b8 cmp ah,al; 0x0054e491 stores it), so each entry is drawn from a small set that makes distinct characters collide (0x52f4b8 record matches at every position and no match) and includes '_' (0x5f), ' ' (0x20) and NUL.
